pairs.subject: engine-binding-surface
pairs.evidence: app/_landing/cosmos/engine/raster.worker.ts:3 The worker and the main-thread fallback both run the repository's own TypeScript job runner over standard browser canvas APIs, and a search of the context directory found no WebAssembly, wasm, PhantomData, thread_local or extern "C" (zero hits), so this code has no binding layer over a foreign engine for the subject to govern.

techniques.evidence: app/_landing/cosmos/engine/raster.ts:333 ImageBitmap.close() is legal on whichever thread holds the transferred bitmap. This release is not limited to one thread, so the technique's precondition does not hold.

app/_landing/cosmos/engine/raster.ts:20 This is a closed two-member union narrowed with instanceof, not a re-expressed foreign class hierarchy. The technique's 'closed set' when-not-to-use case applies.
app/_landing/cosmos/engine/raster.worker.ts:51 The worker's handler is itself async, and no unchangeable engine calls back synchronously for a resource.
